notes.title: Easter update
notes.content:
✨ We're back with a new update! ✨

👀 What's new:

➡️ A new Easter hat.
➡️ The "Play" button now loads the last level you played.
➡️ Arrow keys have been added to the movement controls.
➡️ Demo updated.

🩹 Fixes:

➡️ Achievement tracking has been adjusted.
➡️ Fixed inverted vertical movement with the right joystick.
➡️ Fixed collision issues with some projectiles that hit without dealing damage.
➡️ ...And other minor collision errors.


🥚 The team wishes you a happy holiday! 🐇

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
✨Here's Gelatina is Hungry's last update of the year! 🥳

👀 What you'll find:

➡️ A new Christmas hat! 🎅
➡️ Improved controller settings 🎮

notes.title: Update - 01
notes.content:
[list]
[*]A help button has been added! Now, if you get stuck, you can use it to return to the last checkpoint.
[*]You can now perform a charged jump backwards.
[*]Minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Day One patch
notes.content:
- Fixes on minor issues.
- Fixed Steam achievements not unlocking in some cases.

notes.title: Gelatina is Hungry is already here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Gelatina is hungry will finally be available on Steam on September 21st![/b][/h3]

Come hang out with the devs while we chat, play, and answer your questions!

notes.title: Gelatina is Hungry arrives on September 21th 2024!
notes.content:
[h3]We are excited to announce that Gelatina is Hungry will launch on Steam on [b]September 21st, 2024[/b].[/h3]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iLCR6Wh-Wyc][b]Check out our launch trailer here![/b][/url]

It's been a long journey and we are very grateful for all the support we received <3 Any feedback on the game will be really apreciated, and we will also respond any questions on the Community page.

We hope you enjoy playing Gelatina is Hungry!

[h3][b]Have a feast![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Small Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, jelly fans![/b][/h2]
[b]We have made some small fixes in the demo and improved some aspects of the game.[/b]

[h3][list]
[b][*] Fixed issues with the controller.[/b]
     Some of you let us know that the controller mapping wasn't working correctly in certain menus. This issue has been fixed. In addition, now you can also use the joystick to move Gelatina.

[b][*] Improved some gameplay issues.[/b]
     We have fixed some texture issues and visual feedback. We've worked on sound, integrating new effects, ambient sounds, and audio feedback. We also adjusted Gelatina's speed and other aspects affecting the gameplay.

[b][*] Bug fixes.[/b]
     
[/list][/h3]

[h3]We look forward to your feedback!
Hope you enjoy the demo more with this update :][/h3]

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898453/31071d08dbbd7572b564742bcd358e5ab77122ba.png[/img]

We have been working on the development for several months and this week everyone will finally be able to try a demo of Gelatina is Hungry!

In Steam Next Fest, from June 10th to 17th, you can download the demo on Steam. Any feedback you can provide us and obviously any bugs you can find would help us a lot! 

[b]
[h1]Information about the demo:[/h1][/b]

🔹 It consists of just 3 levels. They are quite short if you can finish them! Good luck ♥

🔹 Two difficulty levels: normal and extreme. In extreme, any damage will be game over! A mode for the most skilled.

🔹 8 accessories to dress up your Gelatina!

[b]Have fun eating everything you can and don't forget to join our Discord for more updates![/b]
